story.title: We build websites the way software gets built
story.lead: {{site.name}} is a web development studio. We design and build custom websites, web applications and digital systems for businesses, creators, professionals and organizations.
paragraphs: Most websites fail quietly. They look acceptable, they load eventually, and they generate almost nothing. Usually that's not a design failure — it's a decision failure. Nobody defined what the site was for, so it became a brochure that nobody reads.

We work the other way around. Every project starts with what the business needs to happen, and every section of the finished site exists because it moves that forward. Design and code come after that's settled, not instead of it.

Technically, we build with the fundamentals — semantic HTML, CSS design tokens, modular JavaScript, component-driven architecture — rather than assembling plugins and hoping they cooperate. It costs a little more thought upfront and considerably less money over the following three years.

highlights.title: Goal first
highlights.text: Structure follows the business objective, not a template's page order.

highlights.title: Fundamentals
highlights.text: Standards-based code that another developer can read and extend.

highlights.title: You own it
highlights.text: Code, content, domain and accounts stay in your name. Always.

items.title: Bill for surprises
items.text: Scope is agreed in writing first. Changes get quoted before they get built.
